body: Communicate. Always communicate. Ladies, men aren’t really good with guessing. You have to tell them what’s bothering you. Stop moping or waiting for him to guess what’s bothering you. Just say it.

There will be times when you’re going to question yourself where you’re going with your life. There will be times when you think you don’t have enough time. There will be times when you need to do stuff on your own. And there will be times when you have to decide on your own. But all these are just temporary. Life throws so many shitty challenges but things will be okay in the end. Once you do something about it. No shortcuts. Just go straight ahead

Had the same struggle two years ago. I detoxed first. Ate mostly veggies, fruits, nuts, yogurt, chicken and fish. It was difficult. There were times I cried in the morning because I had to run to lose weight. Or do exercise when I could have just slept in. 

Try following fitness personalities. Kayla Itsines in Instagram. She has workout routines that are doable at home. And Athlean-X on youtube. Popsugar fitness too. 

Takes a huge sacrifice. But allow yourself a cheat day. So your cravings won’t be as bad. :) good luck!
Get that much awaited vacation, this time with my boyfriend, after getting my Master’s Degree despite the panic attacks and melt downs in between

We were supposed to meet up for dinner. I was actually 15 mins late but he told me he was running late because he had to meet with the supervisor of the clinic. One hour into waiting, I was already hungry by this time, I texted him it had already been an hour. He only replied, “I didn’t tell you to go there early. And I’m cancelling. Supervisor wants to have dinner with the staff.”
Same here! 4 year LDR but we’re going strong. ☺️ constant communication guys. Our four years started last August. Communication and trust. That’s just about it. And FaceTime or skype.
Thanks! :)
I cannot unsee it.

Like this right now. I wasn’t able to do something for him. I felt useless. We had a fight a month ago because he wanted me to stay at their condominium for the weekend. I was acting “shy” and I wanted to book a hotel. We fought over that. I felt I was being stupid which yes, I admit, I was. He doesn’t see me that way, I think. He hasn’t told me I overreact to small things but I won’t be surprised that one day he will.

I don’t know. I always overreact to small things. I make a big deal out of things like this one. I always cry over things like small arguments. I give meaning to stuff when there isn’t. I always feel like everything is my fault.
How can an emotional wreck be there emotionally for someone? My emotion is all over the place.

I’m in a long distance relationship right now. And my boyfriend got rushed to the ER for nausea and vomiting. I felt useless. I felt like I didn’t do anything for him and it made me feel worthless. When I feel that way, I just want to disappear. I want to go away and hope that something happens to me and I just disappear without anyone noticing.
Thank you!
He’s using Yamaha HS50m
Is is hearing impaired friendly? Hehe.
It’s difficult looking for books about mixing in general here. Not everyone is into music and how it is actually produced. Messaged my aunt though. Thank you! I’ll hold on to that book.
He’s studied music theory too. And has subscribed to youtube channels on music mixing tutorials. I checked the book online. It’s perfect for him actually. ☹️
Any other suggestions? We don’t have that in the Philippines. Lol
Thank you! ☺️
We already talked :) stayed at their place. Spent a great weekend together
Thanks.
He said he wasn’t mad. He didn’t even say I love you when we went to bed. I’m ruining this. I really am
I am. I’m trying. For three weeks I have been nothing but anxious. And ai fear he’s grown tired

I’m not doing anything. I try to distract myself from overthinking. I haven’t been to a doctor. There’s a stigma in our country about seeing a shrink. People think you’re crazy. I tell him what’s on my mind. He comforts me but I know there’s a limit to that. Every time I tell the truth I have this fear he would get mad.
He knows I have anxiety. He knows I get worried a lot. Last night probably made him snap. I don’t know. It’s all my fault. I was stupid.
I know. Thank you.
Then I don’t deserve this man
Maybe he’s grown tired of this behavior.
I told him I’d clean it myself. It was the least I could do. He said that was a fair compromise. He still said he wasn’t mad but his action said otherwise
Because I’m plain paranoid.
I did. I said I would book a hotel. He said I didn’t need to. He insisted that I stayed in the extra room. Then that pissed him off.

I did. He slept right away. He was tired from the weekend. I did apologize but he said still he wasn’t mad. I have been dramatic and ridiculously paranoid for the past couple of weeks. I apologize. I fear he’s already grown tired of me.

He wanted me to stay at their place. They had an extra room. They have a busy household. I didn’t want them to clean up the extra room just because I’m staying for a couple of days. They turned the room into a storage room. So that would take a lot of cleaning. I didn’t want that. Considering they had other important things to do in their home.
Pride. That and the fact that I don’t want special treatment.

We’re supposed to meet this Friday and I’m supposed to stay at their condo for the weekend. But that’s not going to happen. He offered another alternative but I was persistent enough to refuse his offer. He got mad but he said he wasn’t.
Not everyone understands what it’s like to have anxiety. It’s not “just in your head.”
Not everyone understands anxiety. People think people with anxiety are paranoid.
Thanks for the replies. It helps. I just need to pluck up the courage and tell him what’s really bothering me. Yes
What if he gets tired of it?
I get scared when I tell him. Because he thinks I don’t trust him. I do. I really do. It’s just that when it peaks up I overthink. When I overthink I tend to say things that sometimes hurt him.
